description: This file defines the CoreConfiguration class which manages application properties, allowing retrieval and setting of properties within a Spring component.

classes.name: CoreConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring component class that encapsulates application properties management, providing methods to access and modify configuration properties.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the Properties object containing configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object to a new set of properties.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property given its key.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property given its key, or returns a default value if the property is not found.
